summary: Under the Bilateral Education Agreement (BEA), Nigeria's Federal Scholarship Board (FSB) nominated students for scholarships offered by partner countries (e.g. Russia, Hungary, Morocco, Algeria, China, Serbia), with the Federal Government adding a stipend. In May 2025 the Education Minister suspended new BEA awards for five years, and in May 2026 the Ministry confirmed the scheme has not been reinstated. This guide tells you how to check the status safely, and how to prepare for the one route that may remain: host-country fully funded schemes such as Stipendium Hungaricum, where the FSB is still listed as Nigeria's nominating body.
lookfor: Past BEA rounds: top school results (7 A/B grades in May/June WASSCE for undergraduates) or a First/2:1 for postgraduates
Age limits in the last advert: 17-20 (undergraduate), 35 (Master's), 40 (PhD)
Completed NYSC and an employer release letter (postgraduates)
For Stipendium Hungaricum: a complete online application, FSB nomination, then a university entrance exam or interview (minimum 56/100)
cycle: No BEA round for 2026/27 or 2027/28: new awards were suspended in May 2025 for five years, and the Ministry said on 1 May 2026 they are not reinstated. The last advert ran 2 Dec 2024 - 12 Jan 2025. Stipendium Hungaricum usually opens about November and closes mid-January (15 Jan 2026 for 2026/27); the 2027/28 call was not yet published when checked.

eligibility.q: Have you confirmed from the Federal Ministry of Education (education.gov.ng) that a new round is open?
eligibility.no: Do not apply through any 'BEA form' you see online. BEA is suspended. Prepare for Stipendium Hungaricum or other awards (PTDF, NNPC/TotalEnergies, Commonwealth, Chevening) instead.

eligibility.q: Are you a Nigerian citizen with a NIN?
eligibility.no: FSB nominates only Nigerians. Check scholarships your own government nominates for.

eligibility.q: Undergraduate: do you have 7 A or B grades in a single May/June WASSCE sitting and are you within the age band (17-20 in the last advert)?
eligibility.no: These were the last published rules; check the current guidance. Otherwise look at Nigerian undergraduate awards such as NNPC/TotalEnergies NMSS or NLNG.

eligibility.q: Postgraduate: do you have a First or 2:1, completed NYSC, and are you under 35 (Master's) or 40 (PhD)?
eligibility.no: These were the last published rules. A 2:2 holder should look at PTDF (2:2 plus industry experience) instead.

eligibility.q: Are you willing to do a compulsory language year or language course in the host country?
eligibility.no: BEA destinations required a one-year foreign-language course; Hungary requires a Hungarian language course. If you will not do this, apply to English-only awards.

steps.title: Check the real status of BEA before doing anything
steps.why: BEA is suspended. Many fake adverts still circulate and some charge fees. Checking first protects your money and time.
do: Open education.gov.ng and look for any new FSB or BEA notice dated after May 2026.
Read the NAN report of 1 May 2026 in which the Ministry ruled out reinstatement.
If you see a 'BEA 2027' advert elsewhere, compare it with the Ministry site. If it is not there, ignore it.
Write down the official FSB contact (fsb@education.gov.ng in the last advert) for questions.
tips: Real FSB adverts said the application 'does not attract any processing fee'.
avoid: Paying agents or buying 'BEA forms' on WhatsApp or blogs.
check: I have checked the Ministry site myself and know whether any round is open.

steps.title: Pick your realistic route and backups
steps.why: With BEA closed, your chance depends on choosing awards that are actually running.
do: Read the Hungarian Embassy's Stipendium Hungaricum FAQ: it still names the FSB as Nigeria's sending partner.
Note the Government said it will still accept partner-country scholarships that are fully funded at no cost to Nigeria. Ask FSB whether it is nominating for Stipendium Hungaricum 2027/28.
List two backups: postgraduates - PTDF Overseas, NNPC/TotalEnergies Master's, Chevening, Commonwealth; undergraduates - NNPC/TotalEnergies NMSS, NLNG, Nigerian Scholarship Awards.
Decide: 'I will prepare a Stipendium Hungaricum application and two backups.'
tips: Preparing for Hungary also prepares you for most European applications - the documents overlap.
avoid: Putting all your hope on BEA returning.
check: I have one main route and two backups written down.

links.t: Embassy of Hungary Abuja: Stipendium Hungaricum FAQ

steps.title: Learn what the last BEA advert asked for
steps.why: If BEA ever reopens, the rules will likely look similar. Knowing them now lets you prepare.
do: Open the 2025/2026 BEA advert PDF on education.gov.ng.
Note the countries, levels, age limits and grade rules for your level.
Note the after-nomination documents: authenticated certificates, passport data page, medical report, birth certificate, indigene letter, police clearance.
Save the PDF for reference.
tips: Postgraduate places in the last advert were in Russia (only if your first degree was from Russia), China, Hungary, Serbia and Romania.
avoid: Assuming a 2:2 qualifies - the last advert required First or 2:1.
check: I know the last published age and grade rules for my level.

steps.title: Build a timeline for the Hungary route
steps.why: Stipendium Hungaricum runs on a tight winter schedule. Missing November preparation usually means missing January.
do: Mark: programme search in November, contact FSB in December, upload documents in December, submit by mid-January.
Then: nomination in February, entrance exams March-May, results June-July.
Set a reminder to check stipendiumhungaricum.hu weekly from October for the 2027/28 call.
Create a folder for scans named 'SH 2027'.
tips: The online system closes at a fixed hour on deadline day (2 pm CET in 2026) - that is 2 pm in Nigeria in winter.
check: My calendar has every Stipendium Hungaricum stage.

steps.title: Choose up to two programmes
steps.why: You can apply to at most two programmes, and each university runs its own entrance exam. Good choices raise your odds.
do: Use the Stipendium Hungaricum programme search to filter by level and field.
Open each programme page and note its entry requirements, required documents and exam format.
Pick two programmes that match your degree closely.
Write down the order of priority (first and second choice).
tips: Pick programmes whose extra documents you can actually produce in time.
avoid: Choosing two programmes at the same very popular university only.
check: I have two programmes and know each one's extra requirements.

steps.title: Get your passport and fix name mismatches
steps.why: Hungary asks for a valid passport (or ID plus a declaration). Every document must show the same name.
do: Apply for or renew your international passport through the Nigeria Immigration Service portal and book capture.
Compare names on WAEC, degree, NYSC, birth certificate and NIN.
If they differ, swear an affidavit at a High Court registry.
Scan the passport data page in colour.
tips: Passport production can take weeks - start now.
check: I have a valid passport scan and consistent names.

steps.title: Collect certificates, transcripts and medical certificate
steps.why: Missing academic records are the most common reason an application is incomplete.
do: Undergraduate: WAEC/NECO certificate and result-checker PIN. Postgraduate: degree certificate and transcript from your university's Academic Office.
Get NYSC discharge or exemption certificate (postgraduates).
Ask your employer for a release letter if you work (the last BEA advert required it).
Have a doctor complete the mandatory Stipendium Hungaricum medical certificate template.
Get any language certificate your programme asks for (e.g. IELTS).
tips: Request transcripts early - many Nigerian universities take 4-8 weeks.
avoid: Using a medical form other than the official template.
check: Every document my two programmes ask for is scanned.

steps.title: Write your motivation letter
steps.why: Most programmes ask for a motivation letter, and examiners use it at the entrance interview.
do: Paragraph 1: the problem or goal that drives you.
Paragraph 2: your studies and experience so far.
Paragraph 3: why this programme in Hungary - name modules or labs.
Paragraph 4: how you will use it in Nigeria afterwards.
Check each programme's length rule and write a separate version for each.
tips: Name specific courses or researchers on the programme page.
avoid: Sending one generic letter to both programmes.
check: Each letter names the specific programme and fits its length limit.
steps.prompt: Why you want this programme, how your background prepares you, and your plans after study.
steps.limit: Set by each programme - check the current guidance

steps.title: Arrange recommendation letters if required
steps.why: Some programmes and doctoral schools ask for letters; doctoral applicants may also need a supervisor statement by mid-March.
do: Check each programme page for 'recommendation letter' or 'supervisor statement'.
Ask a lecturer who knows your work, and send them your CV, transcript and motivation letter.
Give them a deadline two weeks before yours.
PhD: email a potential Hungarian supervisor early and ask about the supervisor statement.
tips: Letters on university letterhead, signed and dated, are safest.
avoid: Asking a referee the week of the deadline.
check: I know exactly which letters each programme needs and who is writing them.

steps.title: Fill and submit the online application
steps.why: Only complete applications submitted before the deadline go to FSB for nomination.
do: Register in the Stipendium Hungaricum online system and activate your account.
Fill personal details exactly as in your passport.
Add your two programmes in priority order and upload every document.
Use the checklist page to find missing items, then submit.
Save the confirmation email or screenshot.
tips: Watch the official 'Application basics' and 'Submitting' videos before you start.

links.t: Watch: How to Apply for the Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship SUCCESSFULLY 2025/26 || FULL GUIDE & Tips (MEKIS)

steps.title: Follow up on FSB nomination
steps.why: Your application only proceeds if the FSB nominates you. With BEA suspended, this step is the biggest uncertainty.
do: Check your email and the online system weekly in February.
Contact the FSB politely through official channels if you need confirmation.
If you are not nominated, move straight to your backup applications.
tips: The Hungarian Embassy in Abuja does not take applications or make nominations - only FSB does.
avoid: Paying anyone who promises a nomination.
check: I know whether I was nominated.

steps.title: Prepare for the entrance exam or interview
steps.why: Universities run exams between March and May. You need at least 56 out of 100 to stay in the race.
do: Read the exam format on each programme page (written test, online interview, or both).
Revise core subjects of your field.
Practise a 2-minute introduction and why you chose the programme.
Test your camera, microphone and internet for online interviews.
tips: Have a backup power source (power bank, inverter or generator) on interview day.
avoid: Missing an exam email because it went to spam.
check: I know my exam date and format and have practised.

steps.title: Results, visa and pre-departure
steps.why: Results usually come in June or July, and you must then arrange your visa and travel.
do: Check the online system and your email for the result.
Accept the award and follow the university's visa letter instructions.
Apply for the Hungarian student residence permit or visa as instructed.
Plan for the compulsory Hungarian language course.
tips: Ask FSB in writing whether any Federal Government top-up applies - under the current policy, assume it does not.
avoid: Booking flights before your visa is issued.
check: I have a written award and a visa appointment.

faq.q: Is the BEA scholarship open for 2027?
faq.a: No. New awards were suspended in May 2025 for five years, and the Ministry said in May 2026 it has not been reinstated. Check education.gov.ng for any change.

faq.q: What happens to current BEA scholars?
faq.a: The Government says existing beneficiaries will keep receiving support until they finish.

faq.q: Can Nigerians still get Stipendium Hungaricum?
faq.a: The Hungarian Embassy still lists the FSB as Nigeria's sending partner, but whether FSB nominates for 2027/28 is not confirmed. Prepare, and ask FSB.

faq.q: Someone is selling BEA forms. Is it real?
faq.a: No. FSB adverts were free and published on education.gov.ng. Do not pay.
Postgraduate: PTDF Overseas, NNPC/TotalEnergies Master's, Chevening, Commonwealth. Undergraduate: NNPC/TotalEnergies NMSS, NLNG, Nigerian Scholarship Awards.
